## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?

Equity leadership (SPY (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +15.38%) ABOVE TREND, XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND) confirms upside bias while defensive assets (VXX (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -18.23%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling, GLD (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling) show mixed signals — net posture neutral.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Tech/momentum strength: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +37.58%) ABOVE TREND driving gains; Energy/commodities surge: BNO (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +7.85% | 1M: +15.08%) ABOVE TREND pushing cyclicals. Credit/funding neutral: HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +1.40%) NEUTRAL and LQD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +0.34%) CORRECTION → HYG/LQD mixed.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-loose. UUP (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -1.15%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling suggests softer dollar; TLT (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -0.39%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling implies modestly higher yields; overall conditions neither tightening nor forcefully easing.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech and semis leading: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +37.58%) ABOVE TREND; Energy cyclical rotation noticeable with XLE (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.20%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary showing weakness: Healthcare sector (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -2.51%) showing weakness.

5. US vs Global?

Europe mixed/catching up: FEZ (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +4.68%) CORRECTION.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative risk is present: IBIT (1W: +1.02% | 1M: +15.09%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +12.46%) ABOVE TREND show healthy flows; small caps IWM (1W: +0.95% | 1M: +11.91%) ABOVE TREND confirms breadth of risk appetite.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity strength led by oil: USO (1W: +7.85% | 1M: +15.08%) ABOVE TREND and UGA (1W: +7.77% | 1M: +19.82%) ABOVE TREND; copper CPER (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +5.50%) CORRECTION — demand signal mixed. Gold weakness persists: GLD (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy showing cyclical re-engagement: XLE (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.20%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: +3.88% | 1M: -6.22%) RECOVERY remains volatile.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Broad equity leadership with SPY (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +15.38%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: multiple 1W vs 1M CORRECTION cases (CPER (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +5.50%) CORRECTION, XBI (1W: -2.15% | 1M: +1.45%) CORRECTION) are minor-to-moderate; no MAJOR core divergence across SPY/XLK/TLT.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor growth/momentum exposure such as XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +15.38%) ABOVE TREND while monitoring commodity-driven cyclicals (BNO (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to defensive hedges that are losing traction like GLD (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND and monitor TLT (1W: -0.90% | 1M: -0.39%) BELOW TREND for rate moves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND — watch QQQ confirmation; Energy XLE (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.20%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND for cyclical follow-through. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND and Biotech XBI (1W: -2.15% | 1M: +1.45%) CORRECTION if downside persists.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Oil USO (1W: +7.85% | 1M: +15.08%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.90% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND — watch supply headlines. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -3.34%) BELOW TREND; copper CPER (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +5.50%) CORRECTION until onshore demand confirmations arrive.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (VXX (1W: -4.67% | 1M: -18.23%) BELOW TREND) = complacency threshold; HYG/LQD parity ~0.80 (HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +1.40%) NEUTRAL / LQD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +0.34%) CORRECTION) = credit health; XLK/QQQ momentum gap = XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND vs QQQ (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +15.38%) ABOVE TREND — watch for tech leadership sustainment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: multiple 1W vs 1M CORRECTION signals (e.g., CPER (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +5.50%) CORRECTION, XBI (1W: -2.15% | 1M: +1.45%) CORRECTION) warrant monitoring for a shift from breadth to narrower leadership.
